title: [DEV] Profile switch takes long time to sync in AAPSClient
symptom: In AAPSClient 3.2.0-dev, enacting a temp profile (e.g., 120% for 30 min) syncs to Nightscout/AAPS quickly, but it takes about 5 minutes for the enacted profile switch to show in AAPSClient. Expected faster display similar to 3.1.0.3 v1 API.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. MilosKozak states 'this is common behavior. enacting profile may take some time', and olorinmaia notes that in dev, AAPSClient says 'profile set OK' asap but AAPS internally visually changes profile and syncs back slower.
fix: The thread references a commit (7cb27fced0a6260bc9486f005b7ab779dade38c8) that likely addresses the issue, but no explicit fix description is given in the thread.
evidence_quote: this is common behavior. enacting profile may take some time
